cases.title: Record visited link to Global History
cases.description: Precondition: Browser is open. Action: Visit a web link. Expected: The visited link is recorded in the Global History.

cases.title: Record correct link after server redirect
cases.description: Precondition: Browser is open. Action: Navigate to a URL that results in a server redirect. Expected: The correct final redirected link is recorded to the Global History.

cases.title: Launch history link in browser window
cases.description: Precondition: History sidebar or manager is open with a recorded link. Action: Click on the history link. Expected: The link is launched in a browser window.

cases.title: Delete single History entry
cases.description: Precondition: History contains entries. Action: Select a single history entry and delete it. Expected: The history entry is deleted.

cases.title: Delete multiple History entries
cases.description: Precondition: History contains multiple entries. Action: Select multiple history entries and delete them. Expected: All selected history entries are deleted and no longer displayed.

cases.title: Clear Global History
cases.description: Precondition: History contains recorded entries. Action: Trigger the clear Global History command. Expected: The entire Global History is cleared.

cases.title: Group History items
cases.description: Precondition: History view is open. Action: Change the grouping option to Day, Site, or None. Expected: History items are grouped accordingly.

cases.title: Sort and reverse-sort History columns
cases.description: Precondition: History view is open with columns. Action: Sort and reverse-sort per history column. Expected: History items are sorted and reverse-sorted based on the selected column.

cases.title: Resize History columns
cases.description: Precondition: History view with columns is open. Action: Resize history columns. Expected: Columns resize to show or hide more of the entries.

cases.title: Show and hide History columns
cases.description: Precondition: History view is open. Action: Toggle history columns to be shown or hidden. Expected: History columns appear or disappear based on the selection.

cases.title: Re-visit sites via Back and Forward dropdown
cases.description: Precondition: Multiple sites have been visited in a session. Action: Click the Back or Forward button dropdown menu. Expected: Recently visited sites can be re-visited via the dropdown menu.

cases.title: Create new empty session history file
cases.description: Precondition: Browser is closed or a new window is requested. Action: Open a new browser window or restart the browser. Expected: A new, empty session history file is created.

opinions.feedback: All proposed high-level cases are fully grounded, executable, distinct, and directly map to the supplied requirements without any blockers.
